description: The Thumbtack adapter of the Eclipse gig family. One approved Task Brief from the Eclipse Gig Core becomes a native Thumbtack request variant: the platform category is mapped explicitly (never a silent nearest-match), the category's own request form is answered from the brief with every difference classified (CATEGORY_MAP, BUDGET_FORM hidden on the classic lead flow, FEE_FORM pro-pays-lead-fee, LICENSE_FIELD, FORMAT_OMISSION, LOCATION_PRECISION), and unanswered form fields are diffs rather than invented answers. Licensed categories block when the brief has not declared its license posture. Pro search results surface ratings, badges, and license claims verbatim with provenance — Compass never asserts a claim is valid. Request quotes are normalized by the shared gig core engine to face price + itemized fees + one all-in total; a quote with UNEXPOSED fees cannot be marked hireable under a ceiling. v0.1 is fixtures only: no live Thumbtack call, no submission, no hire power; live modes are owner-gated G1 partner work.
